substantiveFindings.summary: In s0176 both English fields translate the corrupt received character 積 in 盈加縮積; the Siku edition and the procedure's parallel applications read 盈加縮減 ("subtract for deficit").

Applying the English repair changes the extraction chapterFingerprint/unitDigests and the date-audit sourceHash (which hashes zh, en and literal), so dateAuditStatus will report the zero-item audit as stale.
substantiveFindings.resolution: Host re-fingerprints the extraction with the production applier and the final independent reviewer re-records the zero-item date audit against the amended chapter. Do not copy the old report or change its hashes.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 以差日、差度盈加縮積其星定合泛用積，為其星定合定積、定星。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: with the difference in days and degrees, excess add and deficit accumulate to that star's fixed-conjunction general application accumulation — that is the star's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: with the difference in days and degrees, excess add and deficit subtract to that star's fixed-conjunction general application accumulation — that is the star's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: Received 盈加縮積 has 積 for 減: the Siku text of this procedure reads 以差日差度盈加縮減其星定合汎用積. 積 ("accumulate") is not an operation that pairs with 加; every parallel application in this procedure pairs 加 with 減 (s0173 盈減縮加 for the outer planets; s0179 盈加縮減 for retrograde conjunction). Both English fields translate the corrupt character ("deficit accumulate" / "accumulating for deficit").

nonBlockingObservations.text: 木星周率：四百七十九萬八千五百二十六、秒九十二？
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The Chinese ends with a full-width question mark, a scrape/punctuation artifact; both English fields correctly render the numbers.
nonBlockingObservations.action: No change; not a translation omission and not a people gap.

nonBlockingObservations.text: 以減盈縮減之分，為距合差度
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Siku reads 以減盈縮積之分. Neither reading pairs cleanly with the parallels s0172/s0175 (以盈縮分減之/加之), and the English renders the received text literally.
nonBlockingObservations.action: No repair; no reading is definite.

nonBlockingObservations.text: 即其星其段入其月經朔日數及分
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Siku reads 經朔月數; the received 日數 (days since the mean new moon) is what the procedure computes (s0133 不盡，為入月已來日數).
